approval.confirmation_reference: After the sealed V1 system failure and recommended directory-only replacement A were reported, the user explicitly replied 批准.

question: Can the fixed exact-angle interface and twenty independent corrective geometries produce one leakage-free 11,000-frame objective structural-semantics dataset suitable for three-seed full-encoder correction?
method: Full from-scratch replacement of sealed V1. Preserve the exact 20-Cano-world and 10-AEE-trajectory sensor/teacher method, sample identities, split, thresholds and failure rules. The only implementation correction is to create metrics/cano before the first per-world metric write, verified by a real temporary-directory regression test. Read or reuse zero partial V1 assets.
baseline: The sealed older AEE 6000-frame adaptation data retained only a derived 16x720 view and split garage as validation; it cannot satisfy the new physical-beam identity or multi-geometry generalization contract. It is excluded from reuse.
acceptance_criteria: Exact 20 Cano worlds, 2000 clusters, 10000 frames and 10 train/0 validation previews.
Exact 10 AEE trajectories, 30000 collected raw frames, 1000 retained frames at fixed indices and 10 losslessly verified archives.
All 11000 raw 16x350 views deterministically reproduce stored 16x720 model views and all 11000 objective labels are nonempty and internally consistent.
Train/validation identities are disjoint, source/environment seals remain exact, C09/C10 and all formal benchmark reads are zero, and the final evidence seal verifies.
stop_conditions: Any source, image, tool, layout, ring, timestamp, pose, split, frame, label, LOS, replay, resource or seal drift.
Any outcome-selective replacement, retry, partial failed-run reuse, validation preview, threshold change, training/model execution or C09/C10 access.
Any read or reuse of the sealed V1 partial Zarr, manifest, preview or metric evidence.

estimated_cost.compute: Serial CPU/Open3D plus ten Gazebo/ROS trajectories and zstd-10 archives.

replacement_reason: V1 completed the first Cano world's 500 frame computations, then failed only because metrics/cano was not initialized before its JSON metric write. V1 is sealed and all partial assets are forbidden from reuse.
